title: Tostones
description: Tostones is a dish from Cuba featuring plantain. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Peel green, firm plantains and cut into thick rounds; ripe sweet plantains do not give the same crisp tostones.
Fry shaped portions in small batches in oil heated to about 170–175°C for about 9 minutes, until golden; drain on a rack.
Flatten each par-fried plantain round gently between two clean flat surfaces, without breaking it apart.
Fry a second time at about 175°C until golden and crisp, then drain and salt immediately.
Stir in these seasonings and additions. Taste, adjust the balance and let the dish stand briefly before serving.
